headline: Fisherman's Row, Weathered Expanse Pace Busy Day of Fighting
war_summary: Since the last wires, Fisherman's Row has added ten base events to reach forty-nine in the past day; Peripti Landing and Arcadia remain the busiest. Weathered Expanse has climbed to thirty-five, with Necropolis again drawing the heaviest traffic. Stlican Shelf stands at twenty-one events, The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch prominent, while DeadLands has logged five fresh events in two hours around Callahan's Boot. Marban Hollow has flared awake, its activity centered on Mox. Callahan's Passage, already stirring at last edition, has deepened: five day-events, The Latch and The Procession in the thick of it, and casualties climbing steeply on both sides. Godcrofts still shows eleven day-events but has been quiet in the past two hours. Tempest Island, briefly lively, has cooled. Lykos Isle and Oarbreaker retain high totals without recent flips; Farranac Coast remains hushed after morning trading. Heavy casualty sheets continue from Weathered Expanse, DeadLands, Fisherman's Row, Stlican Shelf, and Callahan's Passage. No victory has been declared.
